name: party-games
description: One launcher app for multiple party games.

scripts.dev: pnpm --dir apps/hub run build && pnpm --dir apps/platform-server run dev
scripts.lint: turbo run lint --filter='./apps/**' && eslint scripts tests --max-warnings=0
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.quality: pnpm run workspace:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run type-check && pnpm run build && pnpm run test
